summary: Albay 2nd District representative with 30 principal-authored bills. Authored annual compassionate paid leave, a Magna Carta for barangay health workers, front-of-package food warnings and mandatory reformulation of high-sodium food. Also authored espionage and foreign-interference prohibitions, regional hospital branches and economic-zone and tourism bills.
caveat: Espionage and foreign-interference bills are one national-security issue, so civil liberties is not scored. Many bills are Albay local measures.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored annual paid compassionate leave (-2, labor), a Magna Carta for barangay health workers (-2), and front-of-package warnings and mandatory sodium reformulation (-2, corporate regulation).
